children: Grown Rogue began cultivation at its Fridley, Minnesota facility and expects the first harvest in late fourth quarter 2026.
Cultivation activities commenced after Minnesota Office of Cannabis Management approved operation on Aug 25, 2026.
Phase I includes ~8,000 sq ft of flowering canopy across five flower rooms; plants introduced room-by-room.
Facility can ultimately support ~30,000 sq ft of flowering canopy, allowing staged expansion as market develops.
First harvest expected in late Q4 2026 with products anticipated to reach Minnesota consumers in Q1 2027.
